descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Every box holds a story.

Step into The Brass Archive, a quiet puzzle collection of walnut, brass and forgotten promises. Read the keeper's letters, study the numbered rings and work out how each mechanism moves. Release the seals, turn the key and discover the keepsake inside.

TEN CHAPTERS, ONE PROMISE
Explore ten authored chapters and sixteen seals. Begin with independent rings, then discover reversed motion, linked gears, counterweights and multi-stage locks. Each chapter has its own finish, letter and collectible memory.

A LITTLE HELP, WHEN YOU WANT IT
Use three levels of hints, from a gentle clue to the next moves. Play without a timer, return to saved progress and revisit unlocked chapters in the memory archive.

MAKE ROOM FOR CURIOSITY
Bring the box into your room in mixed reality, or use the in-app window view. In MR, manually adjust its height, reach and size to suit your table. Use your hands to grip the recessed wells and turn the rings. Touch controllers are also supported.

Single player. English by default, with Vietnamese available. Progress stays on your device. No ads or in-app purchases. Meta platform ownership verification applies.
